_doc.purpose: Language-neutral conformance vectors for the vendor attestation verifiers (AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX DCAP, Azure MAA, GCP Confidential Space, NVIDIA GPU SPDM) and for the strict X.509 readers they share. A native verifier passes when, for every row, it answers exactly `expect`.
_doc.generation: Every `expect` is produced by RUNNING the TypeScript verifier over the row; the generator fails when a row outcome contradicts its `intent`. Synthetic evidence is minted under test roots with seeded keys, so regeneration is byte-for-byte reproducible.
_doc.blobs: Any string inside `config` or `evidence` may be `{"$blob": "<id>"}`; replace it with `blobs[<id>]` before use. Real evidence is stored once.
_doc.encodings: Bytes are standard base64 (padded). Hex is lowercase. PEM and JSON documents are strings. u64 values above 2^53 are decimal strings. Times are epoch milliseconds.
_doc.attestation_vectors: Row: {id, vendor, tags, intent, description, config, now, expected_binding, evidence, expect}. Build the verifier with verifier_from_config(vendor, config) (keys in verifier_config_schema), hand it `evidence` as what its evidence resolver answers (null: no evidence for the action), run verify with clock `now` and `expected_binding` {holderPub, grantRef, epoch, nonce}. The binding the evidence must carry is attestationBinding(expected) = SHA-512("atlas-pca/attest-bind/v1" || 0x00 || lp(holderPub) || lp(grantRef) || u64be(epoch) || lp(nonce)), lp(s) = u32be(len(utf8 s)) || utf8 s; an empty holderPub, grantRef or nonce, or an epoch that is not a non-negative safe integer, is not constructible. `expect` is the whole result: {ok, bound?, reason?, measured?, hostAsserted?} or {construct_error} when the factory must refuse the config.
_doc.reasons: `expect.reason` is the exact TypeScript string. When `expect.reason_match` is "prefix", the reason embeds the message of an OpenSSL / node:crypto exception: compare only `reason_prefix` (the text before that message). Every other reason must match byte for byte.
_doc.intent: `accept` rows have ok true; `reject` rows have ok false or a construct_error.
_doc.now: The verifier clock lives in each row (`now`), not in `config`, so the passport vectors can reuse `config` unchanged.
_doc.tags: strictness: a malleability or DER rule. real: genuine recorded evidence. synthetic: minted under a test root. collateral:* optional sub-features (Intel PCS collateral, NVIDIA RIM / CRL / OCSP).
_doc.x509_vectors: Row: {id, vendor: "x509", fn, tags, intent, description, input, expect}. fn is one of the functions of the strict DER readers; input members `cert`, `tbs`, `chain[]` are base64 DER. expect is {ok:true,value} or {ok:false,error}; error is the exact message of the TypeScript reader.
_doc.scope_notes: GCP rows are synthetic only: the real Confidential Space captures identify a cloud project and are not published.

family.desc: Selects the pinned ARK (SPKI SHA-384). Any other value: construct_error "createAmdSnpVerifier: family must be 'milan' | 'genoa' | 'turin'".

binding.desc: report-data: report_data == attestationBinding(expected). azure-runtime-data: report_data[0:32] == sha256(runtimeData), [32:64] == 0 and runtimeData JSON user-data == the binding.

policy.measurements.desc: NON-EMPTY allowlist of the 48-byte launch measurement (case-insensitive). Empty or missing: construct_error.

policy.allowDebug.desc: Accept a guest policy with DEBUG bit 19 set (default false).

policy.minReportedTcb.desc: Minimum REPORTED_TCB as a whole u64.

policy.requireEcdsaP384.desc: Require SIGNATURE_ALGO == 1 (default true; false only disables that check).

clockSkewMs.desc: Skew applied to both ends of every certificate validity window (default 0; negative or non-finite: chain refused).

trustAnchorArkSpkiSha384.desc: CONFORMANCE HARNESS ONLY: replaces the built-in pin of `family` (the synthetic AMD-format chains are rooted in a test ARK). The TypeScript production API has no such option; the reference swaps the family pin at construction.

identity_overrides.desc: Keys merged over the default measured identity {model_id:"", weights_digest:"", weights_measured:false, runtime_measurement:hex(measurement), operator:hex(chip_id)}.

report.desc: The raw ATTESTATION_REPORT (exactly 1184 bytes to verify).

runtimeData.desc: azure-runtime-data mode: the exact runtime-data JSON bytes.

binding.desc: As for SEV-SNP, on the TD report_data.

policy.mrtds.desc: NON-EMPTY, every entry 96 hex chars (lowercased). Else construct_error.

policy.mrSeams.desc: Optional MRSEAM allowlist; if present it must be a non-empty list of 96-hex entries.

policy.allowDebug.desc: Accept TD_ATTRIBUTES.DEBUG (default false). Also forwarded to the collateral check.

policy.collateral.minTcbEvaluationDataNu.desc: Minimum tcbEvaluationDataNumber of TCB info and QE identity.

trustAnchorRootCaSpkiSha256.desc: Pinned Intel SGX Root CA SPKI SHA-256 (default Intel's published root a0af0312...a49e). Also pins the collateral issuer chains.

allowMissingCollateral.desc: Explicit opt-out of PCS collateral (default false: collateral required).

identity_overrides.desc: Merged over the default measured identity (runtime_measurement = hex(MRTD), other fields empty/false).

trustedIssuers.desc: The token iss must equal one entry exactly. Non-empty.

trustAnchors.rootSpkiSha256.desc: SPKI SHA-256 pins; a chain cert matching one is the anchor.

trustAnchors.rootCertsPem.desc: External root certificates; the chain top must be signed by one. At least one of the two anchor lists must be non-empty.

policy.tdxMrtds.desc: Accepted MRTDs (tdxvm tokens). At least one of the two lists non-empty.

policy.sevSnpMinTcb.desc: Minimum SVN claims; a configured floor needs the claim present and an integer.

policy.runtimeUserDataBinding.desc: Bind through x-ms-runtime.user-data instead of the report-data claim.

policy.tdxAllowedTcbStatuses.desc: Accepted attester_tcb_status values (default UpToDate, SWHardeningNeeded); applied only when the claim is present.

policy.reportDataHash.desc: Hash applied to the binding before comparing with the report-data claim.

clockSkewMs.desc: Skew for the token window (rounded up to whole seconds) and certificate validity (default 0).

identity_overrides.desc: Merged over the default measured identity (runtime_measurement = the measurement/MRTD claim lowercased).

jwks.desc: Instance JWKS; without it the header x5c is used.

trustAnchors.trustedJwks.desc: Pinned signing keys (RSA n/e, EC x/y or x5c leaf), matched by kid.

trustAnchors.rootCertsPem.desc: Roots for an x5c chain. At least one anchor of any kind is required.

policy.allowedTeeTypes.desc: Optional pin; when present it must be non-empty.

policy.nonceHash.desc: Hash applied to the binding before comparing with eat_nonce.

identity_overrides.desc: Merged over the default measured identity (runtime_measurement = image_digest).

jwks.desc: Issuer JWKS; a key found only here must corroborate an anchor.

rootSpkiSha256.desc: Pinned NVIDIA Device Identity CA root SPKI SHA-256. Non-empty.

policy.measurements.desc: Pinned SPDM measurement blocks (SHA-384). May be empty ONLY when `collateral` is configured.

policy.leafSubjectIncludes.desc: Required substring of the device leaf subject.

collateral.rimRootSpkiSha256.desc: Installs the RIM/CRL/OCSP post-verification hook (tag collateral:*). Non-empty pins required.

collateral.revocation.desc: Revocation evidence REQUIRED (default 'crl'); supplied evidence is always enforced.

collateral.requireCrls.desc: Legacy: false makes CRLs optional when `revocation` is absent.

collateral.requireCrlIssuers.desc: Issuer subject substrings that must have a verified CRL.

collateral.firmware.desc: Firmware floor / deny list on the GPU-reported versions.

identity_overrides.desc: Merged over the default (all-empty) measured identity.

collateral.desc: {driverRimXml, vbiosRimXml (strings), crls?: base64[], ocsp?: base64[]} handed to the collateral hook; absent while `collateral` is configured: "no RIM collateral supplied for this report".
